title: Police Tase Suspect After Dangerous Wrong Way Chase In Michigan
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Bath Township, Michigan — On October 6, 2025, around noon, Bath Township police began pursuing a man believed to be armed and involved in a domestic violence case. Officers spotted him driving a silver SUV on I-96 in Ingham County and requested help from nearby agencies as he refused to stop. As the chase continued into Livingston County Sheriff’s Department, dashcam footage showed the driver swerving erratically across lanes, slowing down as if to taunt officers, and repeatedly sticking his arm out the window to gesture at them. At one point, he used a highway turnaround to cross the median and drive the wrong way into oncoming traffic, narrowly avoiding collisions with other vehicles. Deputies attempted several precision maneuvers to stop him, eventually spinning out his SUV near an entrance ramp. The driver exited the vehicle, threw his hat to the ground, and continued to make gestures toward deputies before officers deployed a Taser and took him into custody. He was later turned over to Bath Township police without further resistance.
